description:
About our brand and products: Privada Cigar Club is a premium monthly cigar subscription. We source rare, farm-rolled, and small-batch cigars that most humidors never touch and deliver them to members every month.

What makes us different: We're built around craftsmanship, discovery, and access — cigars our members genuinely can't find anywhere else, curated and delivered like a passport to the best the cigar world has to offer.

How affiliates can earn: Earn 40% on every new subscriber's first order — one of the most generous payouts in the cigar business. No complicated tiers, no catch.

How to promote us: Drop your unique link anywhere your audience lives — social, email, YouTube, your site. Send cigar lovers our way and get paid for every new member you bring in.

Other information: Must be 21+. Privada ships premium cigars and subscription boxes to qualifying regions. Share what you already love and earn for connecting the right people to the club.

Privada Cigar Club — Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

You made it in. Here's what you need to know before you start sending us members.

These terms govern your participation as an affiliate ("you") in the Privada Cigar Club Affiliate Program ("Program") operated by Privada Cigar Club ("we," "us," "Privada"). By joining, you agree to everything below. If you don't agree, don't join.

1. Approval

We approve affiliates manually and reserve the right to accept or decline any application at any time, for any reason, without explanation. No legal recourse applies for declined applications. We also reserve the right to remove any affiliate from the Program at our sole discretion.

2. Age & Tobacco Compliance

This section is non-negotiable. Privada sells tobacco products. As an affiliate, you are strictly prohibited from:

  • Promoting Privada to anyone under 21 years of age
  • Advertising on any platform or channel primarily used by minors
  • Creating any content that could appeal to underage consumers
  • Making health claims about our products

You are solely responsible for complying with all federal, state, and local laws governing tobacco promotion in your jurisdiction. Violation of this section results in immediate removal from the Program and forfeiture of all pending commissions, no exceptions.

3. Your Affiliate Link

You'll receive a unique tracking link upon approval. You can also generate links to specific products or collections from your dashboard. Last-click attribution applies — if a customer clicks your link after clicking another affiliate's, you receive the credit.

Cookies track referrals from the moment someone clicks your link. Cookie duration is listed on your registration page. If a customer clears their cookies or opts out of tracking, we cannot attribute that sale to you.

4. Coupon Codes

Some affiliates are assigned a branded coupon code — if you are, the details will be in your dashboard. If you haven't been assigned one, you are not permitted to promote a Privada coupon code. If a customer uses both your affiliate link and a coupon code, you receive one commission, not two.

5. Commissions & Payment

You earn 10% of the referred order subtotal — excluding taxes, shipping, and tips — for every completed purchase made through your affiliate link, including recurring subscription renewals.

Important terms:

  • Commissions are earned on both first-order purchases and ongoing subscription renewals for as long as your referred customer remains active.
  • Payment details must be configured in your dashboard before any payout can be processed.
  • Commissions on refunded, charged back, or disputed orders are forfeited.
  • We review all referred orders and reserve the right to withhold commissions generated through fraudulent, misleading, or policy-violating activity.

Payment schedule is outlined in your Affiliate Guide.

6. How You Can Promote Privada

You may promote Privada through your own channels — Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, podcasts, blogs, print, and events. Marketing assets (banners, logos, copy) are available through the Marketing tab of your dashboard.

You may not:

  • Run paid ads using Privada's brand name or trademarks without written permission
  • Make false or misleading claims about our products
  • Promote Privada on platforms that prohibit tobacco advertising unless you can confirm full compliance
  • Target or promote to anyone under 21
  • Use spam, unsolicited messaging, or deceptive marketing tactics

All promotional content must clearly disclose your affiliate relationship per FTC guidelines — #ad, #sponsored, or equivalent language is required.

7. Network

If the Network feature is active on your account, you may invite other affiliates. If your downline affiliates generate referred sales, you may earn a network commission per your dashboard settings.

8. Leaving the Program

Want out? Email us at info@privadacigarclub.com and we'll remove you. We can also remove you at any time for violations of these terms, with pending commissions forfeited.

Questions? We're at info@privadacigarclub.com.

Now go build something.
